writing_roles.role: Contributing Feature & Content Writer; Event Organizer & Youth Program Facilitator
activities: Write feature articles, interviews, and accessible design-focused stories for a broad public readership.
Identify architecture, interior design, cultural, youth, and public-interest stories suitable for mainstream publication.
Coordinate and host large-scale national youth events and facilitate youth-centered programs.
Write research-informed content connecting material innovation, design application, architects, engineers, and industry communication.
Conduct interviews with architects, engineers, and industry leaders.
Coordinate visuals, captions, references, and supporting content details.
Manage editorial content from topic selection to print preparation.
Identify relevant stories, projects, designers, industry themes, and built-environment topics.
Communicate with interviewees, architects, designers, contributors, and project representatives.
Write research-informed articles and interview-based content.
Coordinate images, drawings, captions, references, and visual assets; review layouts before print.
